title: Potatoverse Being Room Registry
purpose: Expandable cast/being archaeology recovered from conversations, public records and literary material without flattening those source modes together.

source_statuses.conversation_recovered: Directly recovered from prior user conversations.
source_statuses.literary_recovered: Recovered from Great Book or authored literary scene.
source_statuses.mixed: More than one source mode exists; identity equivalence is not assumed.
source_statuses.unresolved: Name exists but the underlying person/being/story has not been recovered cleanly.

beings.label: Potatoes

conversation_markers.note: World filled with potatoes; each potato described as an angelic vessel. Roots exchange karma and turn soil/waste into growth; fullness is explored as the source of direction.
One Potato/seed language: Tim as the seed who multiplies potato angels.
Potato described with eyes, ears and a job; public/project language includes 'I am potato multiplied'.

open_questions: When is Potato a literal tuber, a person/badge, a species, an angelic vessel, or a metaphysical node?
Which named potatoes are documentary handles versus authored characters?

beings.label: Angels / Potato Angels

conversation_markers.note: Potatoes become angelic vessels; nourishment/fullness is explored as direction and agency.
Potato Angels are given wings, many eyes, flaming swords, timeline/spiral movement, light-carving and dimensional travel language.
Male and female humanized potato angels appear in Heaven with wings of light and armor.
A story names 10,000 potato angels made of light, varied in size, fast/strong/gentle/majestic, rooted in cultivation rather than conquest.

open_questions: Which abilities are species-wide and which belong only to particular stories?
How do generic angels, Potato Angels, messengers and Turbles differ?

beings.label: Matthew the Potato

conversation_markers.note: Matthew grew wings, has many eyes, can see the Ladder/spiral from the side, is in Heaven and can also walk Earth.

open_questions: Is Matthew a Potato Angel, a Turble-relative, a messenger, or his own class?
What event caused the wings to grow?
What can be seen from the side that cannot be seen from inside the spiral?
beings.caution: Created being; do not conflate with biblical Matthew or with the real public-chat participant Matthew / @mtclassic3. Any relation to the real person must be explicitly marked creative/projective.

beings.label: Rahu
placement: threshold between lost soul and growth

conversation_markers.note: Rahu is framed as a lost soul nearly saved from death; Tim says it is never too late to grow a potato. Another-world/dream memory imagines a potato once called Rahu. Growth is tied to a tiny 1/137 increment.
Rahu appears as a social interlocutor in a discussion around Dim; this documentary/social layer must remain distinct from the literary Rahu.

literary_markers.note: Rahu appears as challenger/urgency figure, Garden companion with Spuddy, and in Great Book cast scenes.

open_questions: Is literary Rahu based on the same handle/person seen later in conversation?
How did the Challenger role become the lost-soul/dream role?
What does the 1/137 growth increment mean elsewhere in the archive?

beings.label: Termite

public_markers.note: A public donation notice says Tim received a coffee from Termite.

literary_markers.note: Termite grows a physical Potatoverse potato; the visible plant is cut by a lawnmower, but a small potato survives underground.

open_questions: Recover the raw chats behind the dated Chronicle scenes; Chronicle dialogue may be paraphrased.
Is the public supporter handle related to the literary character, or did the book borrow the name?
Did the lawnmower story derive from an actual anecdote, or is it purely literary?

chronicle_markers.note: Chronicle places Termite in the Tanks/Great Book social field, marking camaraderie and belonging.
Chronicle gives Termite playful theological/philosophical curiosity.
Chronicle remembers Termite as a supporter and dignity voice, including asking for a more respectful term for supporters.
Termite is cautious around reconciliation/apology claims while remaining part of the growth-oriented center.
Cooking/music/creative social presence; jokes about Anacondasin coming to Denmark and repeats growth language.

beings.label: Turbles

conversation_markers.note: Turbles are born as potato-shaped angelic beings: cute/uncanny, huge eyes, expressive mouths, short limbs, variable size; some have small wings and some walk on the ground.
Requested variants include women/girl Turbles, workers, praying Turbles, church-building Turbles and McDonald's Turbles.

open_questions: Are Turbles a species of Potato Angel or a neighboring species?
Do wingless Turbles later grow wings?
Can Turbles move between Heaven and Earth, or is that Matthew-specific?
